subject.title: refactor(state): split openclaw-state-db into focused modules under the line limit

question: Does the state-database owner accept this behavior-neutral decomposition after reviewing fresh-install and existing-database upgrade/open proof?
rationale: The patch rearranges the compatibility-sensitive persistence and schema-repair boundary; tests and static checks do not by themselves establish the real startup and upgrade behavior required for this protected PR.

options.title: Require runtime proof, then approve
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or runtime logs showing a fresh database open plus an existing database reopen/upgrade before accepting the refactor.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Keep the current monolith until the state owner can allocate review time for migration-order equivalence.
